title: 體能表現如何預測老年人全因死亡率：一項1.3萬人的台灣世代研究

source.citation: Wu MC, Hsu CT, Hsu HT, et al. Physical Fitness and All-Cause Mortality in Older Adults. JAMA Network Open. 2026;9(8):e2628227.

study_profile.study_type: observational cohort linking Taiwan's National Physical Fitness Survey Database with the National Health Insurance Research Database
study_profile.synthesis_mode: quantile-based multivariable Cox models plus sex-stratified restricted cubic splines and continuous-value sensitivity analyses

observations.description: The article moves from cohort construction and the seven functional tests to domain-specific AHR gradients, sex strata, spline shape, clinical positioning and explicit limitations rather than following the paper page by page.

observations.description: Favourable mortality associations are paired with the observational-design brake, so higher measured fitness is not presented as proof that improving fitness directly lowers death.
evidence_locations: article:主要發現：分域風險梯度

observations.description: The explanatory spine links balance, agility and lower-body strength to functional reserve and fall-related pathways, while retaining the paper's status as an association study rather than an intervention test.
AHRs are translated with their Q1 reference, confidence intervals and outcome domain, then capped as relative association estimates rather than individual mortality reductions.
evidence_locations: article:主要發現：分域風險梯度

observations.description: The large cohort and standardized testing are paired with selection, single-time-point, smoking and residual-confounding limitations; strengths do not erase the evidence boundary.
Cohort facts, author discussion about functional reserve and sex-specific mechanisms, and the explainer's clinical interpretation are kept as separate authority layers.

Eligibility and measurement procedures are treated as part of interpretation: quota-based convenience sampling and the requirement to complete tests select toward healthier, ambulatory older adults, while smoking is unavailable at individual level.

The limitations change the permitted conclusion: no causal claim, no cause-specific mortality claim, no trajectory claim and no formal comparison of prognostic accuracy with comorbidity-based metrics.
The permitted clinical role is a supplementary functional signal and possible risk-stratification aid, not a validated winning risk model or a proven treatment effect.

Standardized examiners, near-complete mortality linkage and consistent sensitivity analyses strengthen internal coherence, but the observational cohort and missing smoking/body-composition data keep the evidence below causal or intervention-grade certainty.
AHR values compare quintiles in separate multivariable Cox models; they are not absolute mortality reductions and are not automatically a cross-test ranking of predictive discrimination.
evidence_locations: article:主要發現：分域風險梯度

observations.description: The composite index has the lowest reported AHR, but the paper explicitly says it did not formally compare prognostic accuracy using C statistic or net reclassification analyses.

Four cards are semantically aligned; C01 substitutes a 6-minute walk and knee-extension illustration, while C06 repeats the knee-extension substitution and abbreviates the 8-foot up-and-go path. Literal wording differences are retained only in the non-gating legacy exact-text diagnostic.
The register is clinically readable and result-dense: technical measures are translated into everyday function, then immediately accompanied by observational, selection or implementation limits.

observations.description: Restricted-cubic-spline plateaus describe observed sex-by-test association shapes; they must not be rewritten as exercise thresholds or proof that gains beyond a value have no intervention benefit.
evidence_locations: article:劑量反應關係：限制性立方樣條分析

contamination_notes.issue: The phrase '其風險區辨力優於任何單一測驗項目' claims superior discrimination from a lower composite AHR, but the study did not formally compare C statistic or net reclassification performance.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Say that the composite index showed the lowest reported AHR or steepest mortality gradient; reserve '區辨力優於' for a direct discrimination comparison.

contamination_notes.issue: '雖具全國代表性' compresses a nationally distributed database and quota targets into a stronger sample-representativeness claim, even though recruitment used quota-based convenience sampling and test completion selected healthier ambulatory participants.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Distinguish a nationwide data source or nationally distributed cohort from population representativeness, and state the selection boundary in the same paragraph.

contamination_notes.location: 主要發現：分域風險梯度
contamination_notes.issue: '意味著介入的效益可能最集中在體能最差的長者身上' moves from a mortality-curve pattern to an intervention-benefit distribution, although no intervention was tested.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Describe the observed separation as concentrated mortality differences; make any intervention implication explicitly hypothetical and prospective.

contamination_notes.location: 劑量反應關係：限制性立方樣條分析
contamination_notes.issue: '柔軟度只需達到基本功能閾值，超過此閾值後對存活無額外助益' converts an observational plateau into a universal functional or training threshold.
contamination_notes.preferred_handling: Call it a plateau-shaped association in the measured sex-by-test strata; do not present it as an intervention target or a general threshold.
